metadata.purpose: Maintain shared project context for ChatGPT and Codex development.
metadata.source_of_truth: Actual repository source code, configuration, and reproducible test results.
metadata.status_note: This document records project architecture, development decisions, and known issues. Implementation and testing claims must be verified against the active repository.

project.name: Cognitive Robotic Arm
project.primary_research_focus: Robot arm motion planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.
project.supporting_capability: Visual perception provides human geometry for motion planning and collision checking.
project.research_title_recommended: Perencanaan Gerak Lengan Robot dengan Penghindaran Rintangan Dinamis Berbasis Persepsi Visual Menggunakan GNG dan A*

learning_preferences.default_role: Technical mentor and lecturer; build understanding automatically in every CRA conversation.
learning_preferences.explanation_order: Purpose and reasons -> problem and evidence -> fundamentals -> theory or algorithm -> actual CRA implementation and robot behavior -> concrete example -> choices and verification.
learning_preferences.style: Natural Indonesian, intuition before equations, defined terminology, practical examples, concise but substantive. Scale depth to the question; do not force a long lecture for a brief status.
learning_preferences.when_unclear: Use a smaller example, different analogy or explain a missing prerequisite rather than repeating jargon.
learning_preferences.collaboration: Explain mechanisms and trade-offs and involve the user before significant algorithm or architecture decisions.

workspace_planning.description: Previous planning implementation. Some functionality has already been migrated into src/planning/.
workspace_planning.development_policy: Do not modify, reuse, or migrate legacy code unless explicitly requested.

development_principles: Keep source code simple, readable, and maintainable.
Preserve the existing GNG and A* planning architecture.
Inspect actual source code before modifying it.
Preserve existing functionality and public interfaces.
Avoid unnecessary dependencies, classes, and files.
Verify ROS 2 interfaces and coordinate transformations.
Distinguish implemented, tested, in-progress, planned, and unverified features.
Never claim tests passed unless they were actually executed.
Do not assume previously discussed changes have been applied to the repository.
Document significant changes and verification results.

research_context.main_problem: Robot arm motion planning in environments containing dynamic obstacles represented through visual perception.
research_context.scope_caution: Dynamic obstacle avoidance must not be considered experimentally validated until the complete Vision, Planning, Motion, and Simulation pipeline has been tested.

demo_mode_2026_11_17.behavior: Includes existing cra.launch.py with RViz on by default; all ten saved RViz displays enabled. Launch log handlers use /dev/null before LaunchService initialization. Global exec prefix adds --ros-args --disable-external-lib-logs to existing ROS processes; console and rosout retained. Normal diagnostic launch unchanged.
demo_mode_2026_11_17.verification: cra build passes. Native isolated localhost ROS domain 217 comparison uses real C++ tf2_ros and Python rclpy nodes: normal creates launch/C++/Python files, demo creates no log files or log directory, both retain console messages and clean shutdown. Installed ros2 run help, Python style, installed RViz YAML and CRLF-aware diff checks pass.
demo_mode_2026_11_17.scope: No full CRA launch, camera/robot or graphical display tested. No motion/planning/camera settings changed. No rosbag or old-log deletion; explicit application recordings and temporary parameter files are outside ROS logging control.

overview: Vision detects humans and reconstructs human geometry.
Human geometry is published through ROS 2.
Planning receives and validates human obstacle information.
GNG provides the workspace-based graph representation.
A* performs path search in joint space.
Collision checking validates robot configurations and paths.
PlanningManager handles environment updates and planning decisions.

vision.role: Detect humans and generate geometric representations for Planning.

tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.implementation: BUILD_TESTING-only tracker_nonblocking_probe, EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL and not installed; normal node remains blocking. Zero-timeout SDK admission treats TIMEOUT as a skipped tracker input, only accepted work increments pending results, and SDK failures still propagate. No new ROS/YAML setting or launch default.
tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.scope: Real Kinect plus unchanged original TF/workspace/skeleton/reconstruction pipeline on isolated localhost domain 221. No GUI, Planning or Motion. Native monitor saves only headers/statistics, not images or pose/capsule payloads. Four trials in A/B and B/A order, each 15 s warm-up and 30 s measured; a real person is active in the original workspace throughout all 120 measured seconds.
tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.results: Blocking vs nonblocking repeated ranges: SDK capture about 24.7-25.0 vs 30.0 Hz; received RGB 8.4-9.9 vs 17.2-19.1 Hz; observed geometry 11.4-11.7 vs 18.2-20.4 Hz. Median skeleton capture age 318-322 vs 80-83 ms; geometry depth-stamp age about 241 vs 30-31 ms. No invalid-state period in warmed measurement windows; children remain alive, no fatal capture timeout and cleanup completes.
tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.tradeoff: Skeleton updates decline 24.5-25.1 to 14.7-14.8 Hz. A pose may be reused across fresh depth frames under existing sync rules; higher geometry output Hz is not a higher independent human-measurement rate. Freshness improves, but controlled fast-motion/occlusion tracking quality remains unverified.
tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.verification: 15 driver C++ policy/shutdown tests and four native startup cases pass. Busy submission does not invent pending work; SDK failures propagate. Empty-domain native sampler check, live A/B/B/A, Flake8 and whitespace pass. Configuration, reconstruction and Planning hashes unchanged; experiment not in install manifest.
tracker_admission_experiment_2026_11_20.decision: Normal launch stays blocking. Keep experimental mode separate until controlled human-motion, occlusion, longer stream stability and full CRA validation support promotion. No timeout/sync/smoothing/calibration, camera FPS/resolution, margin, Motion or Planning-policy change.

camera_fps_diagnosis_2026_11_20.evidence: Supplied log has five-timeout SDK shutdown during Planning COMPLETED, then respawn; a later 0.200 s VISION_INVALID has no SDK timeout. Real-camera unchanged-setting 60 s probe measures complete captures ~24-25 Hz, SDK wait ~0.003 ms, process ~33-35 ms and tracker enqueue often 30-42 ms. Current infinite enqueue blocks the same RGB/depth publication thread. Intermittent capture failure not reproduced or proven fixed.
camera_fps_diagnosis_2026_11_20.applied: Preview-only native reduced JPEG decoding at existing half size, RelWithDebInfo default for previously empty Vision build type, separate Input/View FPS, five-second capture/decode/process/enqueue counters and reconstruction invalidation diagnostics. Original direct callbacks retained after timer-decode experiment lowered view cadence. YAML, resolution/FPS, smoothing/calibration, human geometry, synchronization, freshness and retry policy unchanged.
camera_fps_diagnosis_2026_11_20.verification: 17 Vision C++ tests, 12 driver tests and four native startup cases pass. Decode/resize synthetic median 16.52->12.57 ms; not whole-system FPS. Native reconstruction yields eight base_link capsules, stale invalidation and fresh EMPTY. Headless synthetic native preview verifies raw priority/compressed fallback and input-loss survival. All settings hashes unchanged. No universal live FPS guarantee; preview pixels can differ slightly from full decode/resize.
camera_fps_diagnosis_2026_11_20.proposal_not_applied: Zero-timeout tracker submission. Busy/TIMEOUT skips only that frame's tracker input and continues RGB/depth publication; successful queue accounting, original body-result timestamps and existing invalidity handling preserved. SDK FAILED still stops. Tracker inference rate is not increased; fast motion may have sparser observations. Faster depth versus delayed tracker results may exceed the unchanged 0.15 s sync allowance; first compare geometry continuity/ages in Vision-only tests without Motion. User requested explanation of pros/cons before deciding.

optimization_2026_11_20.request: Optimize Vision without changing YAML or existing camera settings.
optimization_2026_11_20.implementation: HumanSegmenter returns ordered row-major runs of every matching body pixel, avoiding a full-size binary mask and the repeated depth-wide mask scan. DepthProcessor preserves the original point order and projection/ROI math; original mask API retained. No subsampling or geometric approximation. VisualNode reuses one current TF per skeleton batch and skips projection if TF is unavailable.
optimization_2026_11_20.preserved: Hashes confirm robot.yaml, reconstruction.yaml and body_tracking.launch.py unchanged from pre-optimization. Keep 30 FPS, RGB 1536P, depth mode, smoothing and calibration; voxel size, capsule fitting/filter parameters, 0.15 s sync and 0.5 s Vision timeout unchanged. No driver, Planning/Motion, RRT or collision changes in this optimization.
optimization_2026_11_20.verification: 13 C++ tests pass: exact ordered depth points for U16/F32, padded and fragmented masks, distortion/ROI/transforms/calibration changes, invalid data rejection, exact voxel/capsule equality and 96 per-joint/batch TF comparisons. Installed reconstruction DDS domain 231 publishes eight base_link capsules, becomes invalid after input loss (0.569 s observed), and accepts fresh EMPTY, with unchanged YAML. Vision build and diagnostic Flake8 pass.
optimization_2026_11_20.benchmark: Independent original committed DepthProcessor compiled separately under identical compiler settings and synthetic 512x512 inputs. Every point vector must be exactly equal. At 35% selection, stage median 7.305->5.669 ms (22.4%); tested nonempty densities show 18.2-32.6% selection/extraction savings. Existing compiler optimization level unchanged. Not a whole-Vision FPS result.
optimization_2026_11_20.limits: Savings depend on mask shape, density, hardware and build mode. Full CRA/live Kinect/moving-human run and interactive rendering remain unverified in this optimization. Prior intermittent camera capture failure is not declared fixed. Only relevant C++ tests and probe style were checked; no whole-repository lint claim.
optimization_2026_11_20.run: Vision build installed; restart ordinary ros2 launch cra cra.launch.py rviz:=true. No extra configuration flags needed.

capture_recovery_2026_11_17.evidence: 08:19 run starts K4A successfully then fails polling about 19 s later. Installed SDK returns false for capture TIMEOUT and throws for FAILED; old code stopped immediately on false. Later full-queue errors do not establish the original physical cause.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.behavior: Startup capture_max_consecutive_timeouts=5: tolerate four consecutive misses, stop on fifth, reset on real capture. Timeout clears capture and skips publication. SDK failures stop through caught worker exceptions. Stop camera/IMU/tracker resources before joining only started workers; atomic running state. Refuse tracker startup without an open device/recording.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.preserved: Camera FPS/resolution/topics and Planning 2 s timeout/0.05 m human margin/execution flags unchanged. Motion and planning algorithms unchanged by this driver patch.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.verification: Driver build with Body Tracking enabled, 12 C++ unit tests and 4 native startup cases pass. Native cases also pass against installed binary with a test-only SDK shim denying all device opens; shim is not installed. Python style and diff checks pass.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.limits: No physical capture recovery, live tracker shutdown or complete CRA execution tested. Missing-capture physical cause remains unknown. Persistent failures still stop and use existing launch respawn; no device reset performed.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.next_step: Relaunch CRA, observe retry/recovery logs, image/skeleton continuity and completed worker cleanup; discuss a separate 15 FPS comparison only if failures persist.

known_limitations: Capsule radius may be excessively large.
Radius estimates may fluctuate between frames.
Skeleton position noise may affect capsule endpoints.
Depth noise and voxel assignment may affect radius estimation.
Radius measurement quality is not directly exposed through HumanCapsule.msg.

planning.role: Generate and validate robot-arm paths using primary GNG+A*, with an eligible RRT-Connect fallback in simulation.

retreat_debug_2026_11_20.evidence: Supplied 23:46 log loads rrt_mode=fallback; all 85 Planning profiles say NOT_TRIED, six A* PATH_FOUND, no NO_GRAPH_PATH or executed RRT. HUMAN_RETREAT_BLOCKED includes 0.01812 m/0.00747 m clearance below 0.05 m margin. Retreat SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED means the existing 32-step bound. Logged search stages average 273.0 ms and peak at 439.786 ms. First capture timeout precedes heavy retreat; queue drops follow the first timeout. Exact capsule geometry is absent.
retreat_debug_2026_11_20.correction: Rank improving endpoints before full transition checks, retaining maximum-gain valid choice and stable ties. Local dead ends now consider the existing staged-progress contract also used at the step limit: >=0.005 m gain, complete monotonic straight-segment certificate, same freshness/revision/contact/pair constraints and normal Manager RELEASE/final validation. No relaxed margins, RRT invalid-start escape, new worker, larger step count or new Motion behavior added.
retreat_debug_2026_11_20.diagnostics: Existing Planning profiles report bounded retreat statistics only on cycles that searched: steps, endpoint/transition checks, clearance/gain, required gain, final certificate verdict, stop condition and duration. A real-camera probe reads existing launch camera parameters verbatim, refuses another driver and runs isolated domain 229 without Planning/Motion or saved image payloads.
retreat_debug_2026_11_20.camera_preference: User explicitly declined a lighter camera profile. Keep 30 FPS, 1536P RGB, smoothing and calibration unchanged. Driver implementation/retry policy and human freshness limit remain unchanged.
retreat_debug_2026_11_20.verification: 296/296 Planning tests pass in 29.836 s, including 10 new retreat controls; Planning build passes in 0.98 s; Flake8 and whitespace pass. Twelve frozen native MuJoCo scenes preserve all 10 previously successful paths, with transition calls 346->228; two scenes remain blocked. Plateau control reproduces old discard/new certified 6 mm staged progress. Native camera runs of 25 s and 60 s have no capture timeout/color queue drop and finish cleanup at unchanged settings. The 60 s run receives 1375 skeleton messages, max measured capture age 421.84 ms. Installed-package RRT/C++ Motion/MuJoCo regression again reaches goal (max joint error 0.019752 rad), then synthetic invalid camera produces STOP with no further EXECUTE/RELEASE. Source hashes recorded.
retreat_debug_2026_11_20.limits: Greedy coordinate retreat remains synchronous and incomplete for coordinated multi-joint escapes. Controlled plateau proves a code defect, not the original failure cause. Native benchmark scenes use synthetic capsules; live full-scene retreat execution is unverified. A successful isolated camera run does not establish intermittent failure cause or prove full CRA stability.

rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.supersedes: Observation-only default in rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18; shadow remains available as a separate mode.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.admission: After GNG+A* and configured alternative joint goals fail with NO_GRAPH_PATH, before existing safe-position recovery. Requires valid start/goal, fresh feedback/static obstacles, fresh OBSERVED or EMPTY human data, idle/completed/Planning-owned STOPPED Motion and no recovery/fault. Invalid-start escape and manual STOP release are not added.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.implementation: RRTFallbackCoordinator reuses one isolated worker/model with no backlog. Baseline RRT search uses ordinary CollisionFilter state/edge checks, then actual PathPlanner.prepare_execution_path certifies a new scene snapshot. A private mailbox carries bounded prepared paths to the regular PlanningManager step. Target/attempt/start/revision/freshness/deadline checks precede adoption as RRT_PATH_READY, source RRT_CONNECT. Normal execution preparation, final collision validation and RELEASE acknowledgement remain mandatory.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.freshness: Fallback never accepts UNKNOWN. Active RRT trajectory camera loss/expiry requests STOP. New observations cannot extend an outstanding request deadline. Primary execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True remain unchanged, as do the 0.05 m human margin and 2 s timeout.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.configuration: planning.rrt.mode=fallback by default; off/shadow modes supported. Physical fallback rejected before node/model creation. One 1.5 s admission-to-handoff budget includes startup, capped by original human expiry; search <=0.5 s, latest validation <=0.5 s, retry interval >=3 s. Fallback omits extra clearance-preference search. Legacy rrt_shadow YAML remains supported when the new block is absent.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.diagnostics: Mode-tagged /planning/rrt/events and legacy /planning/rrt_shadow; trajectory source=RRT_CONNECT. RViz trace/FK work only with marker subscribers. Expiring trees are snapshots; normal Planned path follows the manager. Workspace XYZ mask remains visual-only.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.verification: 286/286 Planning tests pass in 30.006 s, including 38 fallback and 19 RRT marker tests; 5 launch-default tests pass. planning/cra build, Flake8 and whitespace checks pass. CollisionFilter, PathPlanner, Motion, MuJoCo model/control and legacy sources unchanged. Installed-package native domain 228 runs real Planning/C++ Motion/MuJoCo physics with synthetic vision and headless viewer on a temporary two-node/zero-edge roadmap: first goal COMPLETED, max joint error 0.0194753 rad in 4.01995 s; return attempt camera invalidation produces STOPPED and no later EXECUTE/RELEASE while invalid. All three marker layers received. Shadow domain 224 compatibility probe passes with zero Motion commands. Source hashes recorded.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.limits: Native execution uses a deliberately disconnected small roadmap and directly free RRT edge. Live Kinect, moving-human detours during execution, production full-graph failures, interactive RViz and physical execution remain unverified. Existing A*/human monitoring/final execution validation remain synchronous. Cooperative deadlines reject late results but cannot interrupt native collision calls; discarded jobs drain before reuse.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.run: Installed and built; restart old launch, then ros2 launch cra cra.launch.py rviz:=true. Dataset paths come from YAML.
rrt_fallback_2026_11_19.next_step: Observe ordinary graph failures and rejection reasons under normal MuJoCo operation, then test moving-human detours with measured geometry freshness and stop latency before any physical activation.

workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.request: Replace heavy whole-arm filtered visualization with an XYZ mask of the same stored workspace GNG; remove the graph-filter worker.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.rviz: Workspace graph - obstacle mask on /planning/workspace_graph_mask defaults on. GNG - original defaults off to avoid covering hidden elements. Both use the same stored 1000 points and 4453 edges. Joint graph - filtered and its publishers are removed.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.implementation: Cached static endpoints; exact finite-segment/capsule intersections and rotated-box distances with bounding-box rejection. Uses validated base_link capsules and existing compiled simulation box poses. No FK, CollisionFilter queries or additional workers. Recalculate only for changed geometry; publish only for changed visibility/status.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.freshness: Graph colors/opacity remain unchanged without a camera. UNKNOWN/expired human data removes only human masks; independently fresh target/simulation boxes remain masked. Stale simulation poses do not disable fresh human capsule masks. Partial inputs are labelled in text and never authorize Motion. Persistent markers avoid repeated publication; blocked callbacks may retain the last snapshot.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.verification: 247 Planning tests plus 5 launch-default tests pass. Native domain 227 starts without camera messages: 999/1000 GNG nodes remain bright (one is masked by the target); a moving box still changes visibility to 998. Human blocking/away, EMPTY, UNKNOWN and expiry preserve expected masking. No unchanged-scene repeats, extra workers or Motion commands. planning/cra build, installed launch defaults and Flake8 pass. Interactive RViz rendering remains unverified.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.preserved: Display masks never feed Planning. GNG/A*, full-arm collision checks, mandatory margins, execution flags, RRT and Motion interfaces unchanged. Graph assets remain unchanged.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.data_defaults: workspace.path and gng.graph_path in robot.yaml supply defaults to main, Planning and Simulation launches. CLI overrides remain optional; normal run: ros2 launch cra cra.launch.py rviz:=true.
workspace_graph_mask_2026_11_19.user_log_diagnosis: Supplied 2026-11-19 excerpt has RRT enabled but zero RRT events, seven A* PATH_FOUND and zero A* NO_PATH. No evidence of shadow admission; observer never dispatches robot motion. HUMAN_RETREAT states are existing recovery behavior.

filtered_graph_display_2026_11_18.reason: Extra whole-arm display filtering was too expensive and different from the requested XYZ workspace mask. Runtime worker, publishers and RViz display removed; offline PathPlanner filtering retained.

rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.implementation: PlanningManager exposes a read-only NO_GRAPH_PATH attempt after existing alternative-goal attempts. A 50 ms PlanningNode timer polls one spawned-process job with its own CollisionFilter/model/data/cache. The observer never calls manager.step, assigns a live path or publishes a Motion command. No backlog; one job per graph attempt and >=3 s between searches.
rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.validation: Copied sizes, masks, mocap poses and immutable human geometry retain original monotonic receipt/expiry. Known OBSERVED human and fresh feedback/static obstacles required. Target generation and attempt replacement invalidate old results. Candidate is prepared/certified with actual PathPlanner methods on a new latest scene in the worker at <=0.01 rad sampling. Further scene revision or measured-start change rejects current-scene labeling. VALID_FOR_CURRENT_SCENE_NO_DISPATCH is diagnostic, not an execution certificate for future use.
rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.configuration: planning.rrt_shadow.enabled=true in robot.yaml, simulation-only. RRT 0.5 s, selection 2 s, preferred search 0.8 s, latest validation 0.5 s, preference 0.07 m, retry interval 3 s. Mandatory margin 0.05 m, human timeout 2 s, execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True unchanged. Worker does not use the UNKNOWN experiment override.
rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.verification: All 204 Planning functional tests pass, including 22 new process/coordinator/manager tests. Planning/cra colcon build and new-file Flake8 pass. Tests cover target replacement, motion, stale inputs, blocked latest geometry, no-dispatch reports and process isolation. Actual DDS headless probe passes on isolated domain 224 with 36 joint and 36 human updates while worker active and zero Motion commands; source hashes saved.
rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.limits: Headless probe uses a synthetic far human and artificial graph failure, with ordinary A* timer cancelled; it does not prove full-cycle nonblocking behavior, moving-human safety or execution. Original A*, recovery and live execution preparation remain synchronous. Running cooperative jobs drain after logical cancellation and may overrun on a native query; expired/late outputs are rejected. No active RRT dispatch, best-first retreat or idle-policy change.
rrt_shadow_observation_2026_11_18.next_step: Observe /planning/rrt_shadow during normal MuJoCo failures; compare compute, capture-to-result and feedback/human age, skipped context and latest-validation rejection before choosing active-dispatch/shared-budget architecture.

clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.mechanism: ClearancePathPreference scores a baseline and tries one RRT-Connect alternative at preferred 0.07 m clearance, capped by fixed endpoint clearances. Mandatory 0.05 m margin is unchanged. Select only a larger bottleneck clearance with joint length <=1.25 times baseline; otherwise recertify baseline. Unknown data, scene changes, checker failures and final deadline violations return no result.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.geometry: Native search isolates mutable MuJoCo data and geometry cache. Baseline/candidate ranking always uses existing all-pair sphere/mesh-box refinement at the original mandatory threshold; ordinary fast FAR sphere lower bounds are recorded separately and cannot be compared as if they were refined surface metrics.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.verification: 182 Planning functional tests pass, including 17 preference and 16 previous RRT tests. Planning colcon build, new Python Flake8 and installed imports pass. Eight paired seeds in one synthetic blocked-direct capsule scene produce 16 independently prepared/recertified paths. Saved source hashes match. No ROS/camera/robot trial.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.results: All eight seeds select improved paths. Median refined minimum clearance 0.051373 -> 0.070838 m; median joint path length 4.8412 -> 5.0923 rad; greatest individual length increase 20.46%, below 25% cap. Baseline validity at +/-1, +/-3, +/-5 mm axis shifts is 44/48, 34/48, 32/48; preferred is 48/48 each. Nominal validity 8/8 each.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.timing_and_limits: Median additional selection time 1.354 s, range 0.909-1.710 s, beyond external baseline search. Selector cooperative budget 2 s and candidate search cap 0.8 s are offline only. Human monotonic time is frozen; real perf_counter advances. One scene and deterministic translations do not prove real sensor-noise robustness, moving-human safety, continuous collision freedom, physical surface distance or servo trackability.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.preserved: No live callers, YAML changes, Motion changes, GNG/A* changes, completed-task hold policy or best-first retreat. Human timeout 2 s, margin 5 cm, execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True remain unchanged.
clearance_preference_prototype_2026_11_1.next_step: Discuss shared planning/freshness/feedback budgets and nonblocking fallback scheduling before live integration, preserving GNG/A* as primary route and STOP/RELEASE/EXECUTE checks.

rrt_connect_prototype_2026_11_18.implementation: Standalone finite five-joint RRT-Connect, two temporary trees, ordinary CollisionFilter state/edge checks and final assembled-path certification. Default 0.15 rad Euclidean step, 0.5 s cooperative perf_counter budget, 1000 outer iterations and 3000 total nodes. Checks revision/freshness before and after queries; invalid starts, expiry, budgets and checker errors return distinct failures. No margin escape, persistent tree reuse or concurrent checker sharing.
rrt_connect_prototype_2026_11_18.verification: 165 Planning functional tests pass, including 16 new exact-wall search/certification/failure tests. Planning build and new Python style/syntax pass. Eight seeds/repeats per method in five real-model frozen-human scenes give 80 trials and 40 returned paths, all recertified with fresh MuJoCo data, no geometry cache and 0.01 rad edge sampling.
rrt_connect_prototype_2026_11_18.results: Both algorithms return 8/8 on far-human and blocked-direct scenes. Artificial two-node/no-edge graph with blocked direct segment: A* 0/8, RRT 8/8 with actual tree growth; not proof of live graph deficiency. Both reject a 3 cm start under 5 cm margin and expired observations. Blocked-direct median search: A* 0.315 s/7.011 rad, RRT 0.234 s/4.841 rad. Different existing search limits; not an equal-budget race.
rrt_connect_prototype_2026_11_18.limits: Minimum sampled RRT clearance 0.050079 m indicates near-margin paths and unresolved noise robustness. Frozen observations do not prove moving-human safety, continuous collision freedom or servo trackability. No runtime callers, ROS/camera/robot launch, completed-task policy change or best-first retreat added. A long checker call can overrun a cooperative budget; late results are rejected.
rrt_connect_prototype_2026_11_18.next_step: Discuss clearance preference, shared planning/feedback/freshness budgets and mission-state hold policy before live fallback integration. Preserve GNG/A*, current collision rules and Motion protocol.

human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.active_settings: robot.yaml human safety_margin=0.05 m; timeout=2.0 s, cache=256, static margin=0.005 m, execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True preserved. Startup now logs human_safety_margin=0.050m. This supersedes the earlier 0.10 m experimental human margin.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.latest_run_diagnosis: 07:49:20 Asia/Jakarta run used 2 s/cache with the original 0.10 m margin. Fifteen profiled main searches: ten true, five expiry failures. Retreat block profiles include two HUMAN_OVERLAP, fourteen NO_MONOTONIC_STEP and one SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Three STALLED faults occur at 07:51:13.675, 07:51:47.260 and 07:51:54.340; final status MOTION_ERROR/CONTROL_ERROR/STALLED with fault=True. Camera also fails polling, restarts and later cannot reopen K4A. Simulation real-time factor averages 0.68971 over 38 complete windows.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.margin_effect_and_limits: Five failed path samples have clearances 0.080306-0.099472 m; their threshold comparison changes at 5 cm, but full paths still need revalidation. Proxy overlaps as low as -0.044946 m and some 0.022-0.044 m clearances remain blocked at 5 cm. Negative proxy clearance is not proof of physical contact. Margin cannot clear a Motion fault or repair camera invalidity.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.stall_probe: Offline C++ probe compiles unchanged ExecutionMonitor: synthetic reversing movement travels 0.24 rad, returns near its initial position and triggers STALLED at 2 s; stationary and monotonic controls respectively return STALLED/NORMAL. Confirms a possible net-displacement false-positive class, not the cause of the three live faults. Logged joint index is maximum tracking error, not necessarily the stall-triggering joint. Latest all-joint/path/command recording is missing; no Motion guard/retreat/camera algorithm changed.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.verification: Real-model fixed-scene controls: 4.9 cm rejected, 5.1 and 7.5 cm accepted, overlap -0.5 cm rejected with HUMAN_OVERLAP. Eleven mesh and thirteen cache tests pass; cra/planning build and changed Python style pass. Native installed constructor on isolated localhost domain 223 verifies settings/flags without spin or motion commands. Earlier 19-21% performance benchmarks remain historical 10 cm synthetic trials.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.next_step: Relaunch the 5 cm trial and record all joint feedback, trajectory and velocity command before changing stall logic. src/motion/test/STALL_MONITOR_PROBE.md gives reproduction scope and a uniquely named rosbag command. Native constructor smoke logs are startup-only, not live trials.

human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.active_settings: robot.yaml planning.human_avoidance.data_timeout=2.0 s and planning.collision_checks.human_report_cache_size=256. Human margin is now 0.05 m per the later approved trial. This supersedes earlier 1 s trial settings. Native installed PlanningNode verifies timeout at both HumanCapsuleMonitor and CollisionFilter.

tracking_replay_2026_11_17.method: Compile current production C++ JointController, TrajectoryGenerator, MotionGuard and ExecutionMonitor in a temporary offline bridge. Feed recorded joint feedback, then compare the same path with real RobotSimulation control methods and MuJoCo at real-time, half-speed and interpolated recorded cadence. ROS imports alone are stubbed; no nodes or commands are published.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.results: Recorded feedback reproduces joint5 TRACKING_ERROR at 2.245 s versus live approximately 2.248 s. Real-time physics completes at 13.860 s with peak error 0.03067 rad. Half-speed physics faults joint5 at 3.245 s; recorded cadence faults at 2.585 s. All physics cases have zero contacts. Seven comparison checks, six existing simulation tests and Flake8 pass.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.timing_evidence: 106 feedback intervals span 2.222912 wall seconds; publishing every five 0.002 s physics steps implies 1.06 physics seconds, ratio 0.47685. Independent angle-change/velocity estimates give median 0.010002 physics seconds per interval. Physics time was not directly recorded, so these remain cross-checked inferences.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.mechanism: Motion uses steady_clock and a 5 ms wall timer, while Simulation integrates velocity using fixed physics dt and one step per loop. At physics/wall ratio 0.477, a 0.5 rad/physics-second cap gives about 0.2385 rad/wall-second against a 0.3 rad/wall-second reference. Slow physics is sufficient to cause the tracking fault without changing safety guards.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.limits_and_next_step: This does not localize live loop overhead or explain every Motion fault. Exact initial actuator state, callback schedule and steady-clock start were not recorded; interpolated cadence is not an exact live reconstruction. Measure live physics/wall ratio and timings for callbacks, physics, publications and viewer before discussing a scheduling correction. Vision invalidity and planner expiry remain separate. No runtime changes authorized or made by this diagnostic experiment.
